comment: Per-version column header patterns for secondary sale registers. Each entry lists the header tokens (normalised: uppercase, non-alphanumeric stripped) to search for when mapping columns. Multiple tokens per field are tried in order; the first match wins. Version 'v1' is the baseline format observed for FY2021-22 through FY2025-26. If a later FY introduces new column names, add a new version key and reference it in secondary_sheets.json.

v1.comment: Baseline secondary register column layout covering secondary order-booking registers. Header auto-detected by scanning first 20 rows for a row containing at least one header_anchor_token. Amount column is 'Sub Total' in FY2021-22 through FY2023-24 and 'Order Value' in FY2024-25. Head dimension comes from 'Distributor' (no State Head column exists in register files). Month derived from 'Date' column (Excel serial or formatted date string).

v1.comment_sub_total_skip: Tokens that, when found in any of the first five cells of a data row, mark it as a sub-total/summary row to be excluded. Only the first five cells are scanned to avoid false positives on amount columns. Note: 'SUBTOTAL' also appears as the column header name in FY2021-22 through FY2023-24, but isSubTotalRow() is only applied to data rows (after the header), whose first five cells are always: serial number, date, retailer name, retailer ID, segment — so no false positives.
v1.comment_header_detection: Header row must contain at least one of header_anchor_tokens after normalisation. Scan the first 20 rows. FY2024-25 has a totals row at row 0 and the real header at row 1 — the 20-row scan covers both.
